verdict.rationale: Base44's own Superagent docs describe workflows that run on a schedule or fire on triggers from connected tools. That covers both recurring and event-driven autonomous execution, not just one-off actions. The meeting-notes Superagent shows background autonomy end to end: it records, writes notes and emails them without user involvement. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of workflow configuration and monitoring, independent or hands-on corroboration that background workflows run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A workflow runs on a schedule or when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool.
It records the meeting, writes up the notes and action items, saves them to its notes library, and emails them to you when the meeting ends.
they update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools so you can run more of your process through one conversation.
